text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Security official says no organised crime in Kuwait.

- Kuwait's people will not forget the role of former U.S. president George Bush in Kuwait's liberation war, Information Minister Sheikh Saud Nasser al-Sabah says. The United States in 1991 led a coalition force to end Iraq's seven-month occupation.
- Kuwaitis' losses due to the 1990-91 occupation amounted to $40 billion, official says. Kuwait's total losses from the occupation have been put at about $120 billion.
- Kuwaiti pilgrims in Saudi Arabia in good health, official says. Some 343 people were killed and 1,537 injured in a blaze during the annual Moslem pilgrimage to Mecca.
- Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad Khaled al-Sabah inspects border posts.
